text:
Maya: quick heads-up — when importing saved queries into console, per-route filters with the same slug but different owners are clobbering each other.
Alex: repro steps?
Maya: create saved query A on /routes/payments by @maya with filter tag:region=us, export, then import via API as @sam -> overwrites owner and policy
Sam: I saw this during quota rollouts too, annoying.
Irene: hmm, expected a merge dialog. Is this only for imports or also UI copy/save-as?
Maya: import-only for now. UI copy/save-as creates a new id, but API import upserts based on slug.
Alex: we probably should avoid slug-based upsert or add an explicit conflict strategy flag. proposal: `conflict_strategy: 'handshake'|'overwrite'|'skip'` in import API.
Sam: +1 to explicit flag. 'handshake' would create a pending ownership claim that notifies current owner.
Maya: rough API example:
```
POST /api/v1/saved_queries/import
{
  "slug": "payments-top-errors",
  "filters": {"region":"us"},
  "conflict_strategy": "handshake",
  "claimant": "sam@redwood.com"
}
```
merge-bot: created ticket #INC-4821 for ownership handshake flow :ticket:
Irene: UX note — in console, handshake should surface as a small banner on the existing saved query with Accept / Decline. Avoid modal spam.
Alex: also need telemetry events: `saved_query.import.attempt`, `saved_query.import.conflict`, `saved_query.claim.accepted`
Sam: who owns the claim TTL? if not accepted in 7 days auto-skip? maybe configurable per org.
Maya: agree. defaults: 7 days -> auto-skip (create new copy) ; admins can force-accept.
Irene: OK, can we mock the banner copy? "User Sam attempted to import a query. Accept to transfer ownership or Decline to create a personal copy." short and actionable.
Maya: I'll draft a short proposal and UX mock, pinging @design. thanks all :sparkles:
Alex: assign to eng-api to spec OpenAPI change, I'll add to sprint board.
Sam: noted. will add telemetry checklist.
merge-bot: ticket updated with sprint tags #api #console
